outcome: Pulmonary function (FEV1, FVC, FEV1/FVC ratio, FEF25%-75%)
cohort: 150 preterm children aged >=5 years born between 2005 and 2015
finding: School-aged children with severe BPD experienced airflow limitations and structural abnormalities even without noticeable respiratory symptoms, with prenatal oligohydramnios significantly associated with both poor pulmonary function and high chest CT scores.
